These pinned crates are from crates.io. License texts below are copied from each crate's distributed LICENSE-MIT file. jiff-tzdb also contains bundled IANA Time Zone Database data, released into the public domain; its accompanying notice is reproduced after the MIT licenses.

IANA Time Zone Database data notice
===================================

jiff-tzdb embeds data from the IANA Time Zone Database. Its source crate describes the data as coming from the IANA Time Zone Database "data only" distribution and includes this public-domain dedication in its UNLICENSE file:

This is free and unencumbered software released into the public domain.

Anyone is free to copy, modify, publish, use, compile, sell, or
distribute this software, either in source code form or as a compiled

means.
